context: A formal business meeting — Hiroshi-boss, Ryosuke (now formally connected), and Tatsuya for an even bigger expansion.
purpose: three-business-leader careful expansion — adult professional alliance deepening

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本日は、新規事業の計画について、ご相談したく。
lines.en: Today, about the new business plan, wish to consult.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal authoritative-professional-warm opening, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ようこそ、田中さん。今日は、私もしっかり聞きます。
lines.en: Welcome, Tanaka-san. Today, I'll listen carefully.
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal-rural professional-warm respect, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今回、私から、お二人をつなげさせていただきました。
lines.en: This time, I let me connect you two.
lines.style: Father warm formal sincere professional-warm bridging-formally, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 達也さんとは、すでに何度か取引させていただいてます。
lines.en: With Tatsuya-san, we've done business several times already.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal sincere-professional-warm contextualizing, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 信頼してもろてます。今回も、誠実にやらせていただきます。
lines.en: You've trusted me. This time too, I'll work honestly.
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal-rural sincere-professional-warm committing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回は、もう少し規模を大きくして、長期契約を提案したい。
lines.en: This time, slightly larger scale — long-term contract I'd like to propose.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal authoritative-strategic-warm proposing, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 長期…責任が増えますな。けど、信頼してもろてる以上、応えたい。
lines.en: Long-term… responsibility grows. But, given trust, I want to respond.
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal sincere-careful-warm thoughtful-committing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 達也さん、こちらでも、ちゃんとサポートさせていただきます。
lines.en: Tatsuya-san, on our side too — we'll support properly.
lines.style: Father warm formal sincere committed-warm offering-formal, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 計画書、こちらに用意しました。ご確認ください。
lines.en: Plan document — prepared here. Please confirm.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal professional-warm presenting, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: …なるほど。けっこう、しっかり練ってありますな。
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal sincere-impressed-warm acknowledging, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ご家族や、お仕事のこと、ちゃんと考えてからのご判断を。
lines.en: After thinking about family and work, please judge.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal sincere-respectful-warm patient closing, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お返事、一週間ほど、いただいてもよろしいですか。
lines.en: For my answer, could I have about a week?
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal sincere-careful-warm asking, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: もちろん、ゆっくりお考えください。
lines.style: Father warm formal gentle sincere-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ご検討、心からお願いします。
lines.en: Your consideration — from the heart, I ask.
